keywords: Inspection process 2.Effective 3.Data handling skill 4.Reliability 5.Science and technology PBL
educationalGoal: Students will:(1) learn a skill of inspection process of a hypothesis or the solution to the problem concept,(2) understand a phenomenon, an object, a phenomenon quantitatively and qualitatively,(3) tell information to a third party clearly,(4) learn various skills required for pushing forward inspection activity smoothly,(5) imagine a technical area and an engineer image to learn in architecture.
advice: Students learn how to lead processes to inspect a hypothesis or learn how to lead processes to inspect effectiveness / acceptance characteristics of the specific part among the characteristics of a concept aiming at a solution to the problem or the concept.In part students learn "a building design skill" to need data in collection → rearranging → analysis → hypothesis → visualization → report. In part "a structure design skill" to lead to the inspection, "an environmental design skill" and "an element skill of the inspection activity" are learned by the drafting of the hypothesis.(1) Building design skill:Students announce the design of a house that an individual designed in a group and narrow it down to one basic design plan based on exchange of opinions. Students make the 1/20 model of the house.(2) Structure design skill:Based on basic design plan, students examine construction and how to structure and the method of construction. Students examine examination and the transformation of the material of the Class basic axis and perform the loading experiment with the model.(3) Environmental design skill:Based on basic design plan, students perform the examination of the environmental characteristic (insulation characteristics, sound, illumination, air conditioning, ventilation) while using analysis tools.(4) Inspection activity skill: Students summarize result provided by a series of design activity in a project report and announce the team by a poster session and plan communalization of the knowledge in the whole class.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable to have the experience that worked on design of a house in individuals as a design problem. It is desirable to learn the basics of how to write building plan. It is desirable to review the common rule including how to write dimensions, a building term and the drawing symbol that the design is a team and will wrestle.

achievementLevels.ideal: Using the technique that student devised by a team, students inspect solution suggestion and can evaluate it from plural viewpoints logically. Based on an evaluation result of the solution suggestion, student can review a design of the suggestion. Furthermore, student can think about social use of the solution suggestion. Student can summarize activity result in a project report in a logical sentence clearly. Student can explain activity result by a poster and a presentation clearly. Furthermore, student can cope with questions and answers appropriately.
achievementLevels.standard: Using the technique that student devised by a team, student can evaluate solution suggestion. Based on an evaluation result of the solution suggestion, student can review a design of the suggestion. Student can summarize activity result in a project report. Student can explain activity result by a poster and a presentation clearly. *Tardy and absence, the negative activity (team activity nonparticipation) deduct points of a personal acquisition point as a penalty of the action posture.

lessons.content: ・Guidance ・Team member self-introductions ・Team information registration ・Confirmation of class rules ・Explanation of how to work on PD notes ・Reexamination of individual home designs ・Selection of team proposals from individual home design proposals ・Explanation of preparations for the next class
lessons.assignments: Team: Preparations for team file Preparation of team member sheet Individual: ・Create a self-introduction sheet ・Prepare PD notes ・PD notes (literature research: safety, verification preparation) ・Bring together individual home design projects

lessons.content: ・Lecture (environmental consideration) ・Explanation of the environmental evaluation sheet ・Discuss environmental evaluation items based on the selected home design ・Start considering the environmental characteristics of the designed home ・Consider the insulation performance of thermally important parts ・Create supporting documents for the environmental evaluation sheet ・Explanation of the examination method using light environment simulation (DIALUX) and airflow simulation (STREAM)
lessons.assignments: Team: Review of environmental assess ment sheet Creation of individual respons ibilities list Individual: Review of items according to individual responsibilities PD notes (environmental charac teristics self-check task contents)

lessons.content: ・Lecture (environmental assessment) ・Environmental assessment using environmental assessment sheets (ongoing) ・Analysis using simulation software
lessons.assignments: Team: ・Create an environmental assessment sheet. Individual: ・Introduce simulation software.

lessons.content: ・Lecture (environmental characteristics) ・Explanation of the environmental characteristics sheet. ・Consider three items among the environmental characteristics.
lessons.assignments: Team: ・Creating an environmental characteristics sheet. Individual: Practice notebook (activity report of the construction pl an).

lessons.content: ・Revising design drawings to reflect environmental considerations. ・Drawing up plans for redesigned homes.
lessons.assignments: Team: Creating redesign drawings. Individual: Practice notebook (activity report of the construction plan).

lessons.content: ・Redesign (design) ・Revise design drawings to reflect environmenta l considerations ・Draw design drawings ・Explanation of how to create posters ・Start creating presentation posters
lessons.assignments: Team: Poster creation. Individual: Practice notebook (activity report of the construction plan).

lessons.content: Poster session Check the questions and the findings of the session with the team
lessons.assignments: Team: Answer the impression questionnaire by looking at other teams. Individual: Practice notebook (activity report of the construction plan).

lessons.content: ・Lecture (structural considerations) ・Consider the external structural forces of the designed house ・Consider floor joists (vertical load, horizontal load) ・Consider floor joists (part of the floor structure)
lessons.assignments: Team: Answer the impression questionnaire by looking at other teams. Individual: Practice notebook (activity report of the construction plan).

lessons.content: ・Continued structural improvements ・Calculated the weight of the designed house and proposed structural improvements ・Considered the wall volume (calculated earthquake force)
lessons.assignments: Team: ・Wall volume calculation Individual: ・PD Note (try calculating wall volume yourself)

lessons.content: ・Continued structural improvements ・Wall volume calculation ・Creating a structural model of the load-bearing wall
lessons.assignments: Team: ・Creating a structural model of a wall Individual: ・PD Note (Ideas for structu ral models)

lessons.content: ・Continuation of structural improvements ・Experimental verification of the shear wall model using a vibration device
lessons.assignments: Team: ・Model testing of load-bear ing walls and preparation of structural reports Individual: Practice notebook (Your own thoughts).

lessons.content: Reviewing redesign proposals from environmental and structural perspectives ・Creating redesign drawings
lessons.assignments: Team: ・Create redesign drawings ・Create structural reports [Individual] ・PD notes (Learned from creat ing the model) ・Answer surveys

lessons.content: ・Revising redesign drawings (continued) ・Creating presentation poster (checking) ・Completing and printing poster ・Submitting structural report
lessons.assignments: Team: ・Poster creation and presenta tion practice ・Report submission regarding structural considerations Individual: Practice notebook ・PD notes (observation records regarding poster creation)

Team: ・Poster session team sheet submission ・Team file submission. Individual: ・PD notes (insights gained from the poster session) ・PD note submission ・Responses to a questionnaire about the poster session

lessons.content: PowerPoint form announcement by a chosen excellent team (within 8 teams). Looking and grading of the class contents. Rearranging and presentation of the presentation file. Self-check.
lessons.operation: Select Team presentation. Confirmation of results. Look back on the whole lecture.
lessons.assignments: Team: Presentation. Individual: Perform the self-check for the action of the class. Submission of achievement assessment portfolio. Clase questionnaire.
